description: Compact API docs for data-gap APIs (R321 not_covered_apis). Extracted from pyAether MCP get_api_details responses, trimmed to core signature+description+example (verbose 补充说明 sections removed).

apis.description: Get layer number of the EmyLPPHeader. Returns emyLayerNum (out parameter).
apis.example:
>>> import pyAether
>>> lpp_header = pyAether.EmyLPPHeader.create(None, 1, 12)
>>> res = lpp_header.getLayerNum()

apis.description: Get maskNum value of the EmyLPPHeader. Returns emyInt4 (out parameter).
apis.example:
>>> import pyAether
>>> lpp_header = pyAether.EmyLPPHeader.create(None, 1, 12)
>>> res = lpp_header.getMaskNum()

apis.description: Get packet name of the EmyLPPHeader. Returns the packet name as a string. Default is empty string for newly created EmyLPPHeader; use setPacketName() to set it. There is also a static overload getSpecPacketName(tech, layerNum, purposeNum).
apis.example:
>>> import pyAether
>>> lpp_header = pyAether.EmyLPPHeader.create(None, 1, 12)
>>> res = lpp_header.getPacketName()
>>> lpp_header.setPacketName("my_packet")
>>> res = lpp_header.getPacketName()

apis.description: Gets an array of points of GuCartPolyLine. The pointArray parameter is an output parameter of type emyPointArrayF that stores the result. Must pass a valid emyPointArrayF object (not a Python list). Use toList() to convert result to a Python list. Point order is preserved from creation.
apis.example:
>>> import pyAether as pyScript
>>> arr0 = pyScript.emyPointArrayF()
>>> arr0.append((0.2, 1.3))
>>> arr0.append((2.6, 4.5))
>>> gu_poly_line = pyScript.GuCartPolyLine(arr0)
>>> array_f = pyScript.emyPointArrayF()
>>> gu_poly_line.getPointArray(array_f)
>>> array_f
[(0.2, 1.3), (2.6, 4.5)]

apis.description: Set the sweep range for DC analysis. The sweepRange parameter must be a MdeSweepRange object. Use MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_CENTER_SPAN mode with center+span, or MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_START_STOP mode with start+stop. All numeric values should be passed as strings.
apis.example:
import pyAether as ae
sr = ae.MdeSweepRange()
sr.mode = ae.MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_CENTER_SPAN
sr.center = "10"
sr.span = "10"
dc = ae.MdeDcAnalysis()
dc.setSweepRange(sr)

apis.description: Span value for center-span sweep mode. String type property. Used together with center to define the sweep range: actual range = [center - span/2, center + span/2]. Only meaningful when mode = MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_CENTER_SPAN. Supports numeric strings, scientific notation, and EDA unit suffixes.
apis.example:
import pyAether as pyScript
sweep_range = pyScript.MdeSweepRange()
sweep_range.mode = pyScript.MDE_SWEEP_RANGE_CENTER_SPAN
sweep_range.center = "2.5"
sweep_range.span = "0.5"
current_span = sweep_range.span

apis.description: Invert the transformation represented by emyTransformF. Returns a new transform with inverted orientation and offset.
Get the orientation component of the emyTransformF transformation.
